in_marathi.name: Dutta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dutta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘datta’, meaning ‘given’ or ‘giver’. The name Dutta is a title given to those who selflessly serve and devote themselves to God or a deity. In Hindu mythology, Dutta is the name of several gods and goddesses, including the god of knowledge, Dattatreya, and the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi.
